patterns: APPSC asks MGNREGA basics directly: year enacted (2005), 100 days, objective = livelihood security of rural households, geo-tagging via Bhuvan.
Older APPSC items test programme lineage: JRY restructured 1999 as Jawahar Gram Samridhi Yojana; PMRY (1993) = post-1991 programme; PMRY implementing agency (DIC).
Recurring traps: guarantee is per household not per adult; eligibility is any rural household (not BPL/SC/ST); renamed MGNREGA 2 Oct 2009; nationwide from 1 April 2008.
Wage vs self-employment classification (PMRY is not wage employment) is a favourite statement/odd-one-out shape.
App adds heavy 2025-26 content (VB-G RAM G, PM-VBRY); PYQs stick to MGNREGA fundamentals and older scheme lineage.
